paras: 本站是美国大城市保障房抽签的日历：收纽约 Housing Connect、旧金山 DAHLIA、洛杉矶 Access Housing LA、圣何塞 Housing Portal 与波士顿 Metrolist 的公开抽签，按截止日排，正在开放的在前、快截止的置顶。每半小时刷新一次官方公开数据，帮读者在截止日前看到新盘，而不是错过之后才知道。
抽签是很多中低收入家庭拿到低于市价房源的主要通道，但各城市的系统彼此割裂，没有统一日历；一个盘的申请窗口常常只有三周左右，错过就只能等下一轮。

按市房屋保护与开发局（HPD）与 NYU Furman Center 公开报告里的大意：2024 年，纽约 Housing Connect 上大约 600 万份申请去争大约 1 万套房，平均每套房背后有约 541 份申请；HPD 说 2024 年通过抽签安置了 1 万多户家庭；2024 年 9 月到 2026 年 8 月这两年里，一共办了 591 场抽签、放出 23,820 套房。数字是转述，不是抄原文。
点评：供给远远跟不上申请量，所以本站的重点不是罗列所有盘，而是把“还来得及申请、还剩几天”放在最显眼的位置。
采集——纽约市公开数据（NYC Open Data）上的 Housing Connect 抽签数据集、旧金山 DAHLIA 公开房源、洛杉矶 Access Housing LA、圣何塞 Housing Portal 与波士顿 Metrolist 公开房源，每半小时拉一次，只取城市、套数、截止日、房源类型这些事实。
改写——每条的标题与一句话简介都是本站自己写的，还带一句自己的点评（比如还剩几天、适合谁）；不转载官方的原文标题、正文与摘要。
排序——按截止日排，快截止的在前；已过截止日的抽签会从精选与热点里撤下。
申请——每条都链回官方申请页，申请本身请在官方页面完成，本站不代收任何申请。

数据来自 NYC Open Data 公开数据集 vy5i-a666（Advertised Lotteries on Housing Connect by Lottery）与 Housing Connect 官方申请页、旧金山 DAHLIA 公开房源（housing.sfgov.org）、洛杉矶 Access Housing LA（access.housing.lacity.gov）、圣何塞 Housing Portal（housing.sanjoseca.gov）与波士顿 Metrolist（boston.gov/metrolist）。本站只展示自己改写的标题、一句话简介、事实字段（城市、套数、截止日）与官方链接，不转载原文标题、正文或摘要。
由 Staroltest 维护。喜欢本站可以扫页脚的赞赏码支持（USDT）。

This site is a calendar for affordable-housing lotteries in major US cities. It covers public NYC Housing Connect, San Francisco DAHLIA, Los Angeles Access Housing LA, San Jose Housing Portal and Boston Metrolist lotteries, sorted by deadline: open lotteries first, closing soon at the top. It refreshes the official open data every 30 minutes, so readers see new openings before the deadline instead of after it.

Lotteries are the main route for many low- and middle-income households to a below-market home, but each city's system is separate and there is no unified calendar. One opening often stays open for only about three weeks, and missing it means waiting for the next round.

In the broad strokes of public reports from the NYC Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) and the NYU Furman Center: in 2024, about 6 million applications chased about 10,000 homes on NYC Housing Connect, roughly 541 applications per home on average. HPD says more than 10,000 households were placed through lotteries in 2024. From September 2024 to August 2026, there were 591 lotteries offering 23,820 homes. These figures are paraphrased here, not copied.
Our take: supply trails demand by a wide margin, so this site focuses less on listing every opening and more on showing what is still open and how many days are left.

Collect — the NYC Open Data Housing Connect lottery dataset, San Francisco DAHLIA public listings, Los Angeles Access Housing LA, San Jose Housing Portal and Boston Metrolist public listings, fetched every 30 minutes, using only facts: city, unit count, deadline and listing type.

Rewrite — every title and one-line summary is written by this site, with a short note of our own (for example, how many days are left and who it may suit). We do not republish the official headline, body or summary.
Sort — by deadline, soonest first. Lotteries past their deadline leave the featured and hot lists.
Apply — every entry links back to the official application page. Applications themselves must be completed on the official page; this site does not collect applications.

Data comes from the NYC Open Data public dataset vy5i-a666 (Advertised Lotteries on Housing Connect by Lottery) and the official Housing Connect application pages, San Francisco DAHLIA public listings (housing.sfgov.org), Los Angeles Access Housing LA (access.housing.lacity.gov), San Jose Housing Portal (housing.sanjoseca.gov) and Boston Metrolist (boston.gov/metrolist). This site only shows its own paraphrased titles, one-line summaries, factual fields (city, unit count, deadline) and the official link. It does not republish original titles, bodies or summaries.
